sec_ai_howto: COMO USAR O AI STUDIO E FERRAMENTAS DE VÍDEO
ai_how1_title: ✨ AI Video Highlight Studio & Auto Re-Layouts (Videos ≥ 5 min)
ai_how1_desc: Select a video ≥ 5 minutes and press Ctrl + G. Click AI Highlight to open Ring 2: toggle 9:16 Auto Layout (1 Face → Speaker Crop, 2 Faces → Top/Bottom Split-Screen, Slide/Screen → Fit Center), 9:16 Fit Center, or 16:9 Original, then choose Smart Clips, AI Summary, Best Moments, or Clean Speech.
ai_how2_desc: Select 2 or more video files in File Explorer and press Ctrl + G. The center hub displays your exact merge sequence (click ⇅ Order to flip order if needed), then click Merge Video to join them into one MP4.
ai_how3_desc: Select any video or audio file, press Ctrl + G, and click AI Subtitles. Pick SRT, VTT, ASS, or TXT — Whisper AI automatically detects the spoken language (99+ languages) and generates exact timeline-synced subtitles.
ai_how4_title: 🔤 Subtitle Format Conversion, Burn Captions & AI Dubbing
ai_how4_desc: Select any video to burn stylized word-by-word captions (5 styles) or run context-aware AI Dubbing across 100+ languages. Select any .SRT, .VTT, or .ASS file to convert formats or translate with 100% preserved timestamps.
